checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add MIDI file inspection

impact_assessment.why: MIDI can be exported and imported but there is no read-only way to inspect a file's format, tracks and recovered musical content.
impact_assessment.benefits: midi-info prints a deterministic summary of a MIDI file's header and the score recovered by the existing import path.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: header must be valid MThd, format/tracks/division exact, score metrics from import stable, invalid files fail; dependency: std only, reuse midi_import; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests pinning the full report for MIDI generated by the project's writer, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 372 tests green; header fields and recovered metrics pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-midi-info' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 9a0aaab5c180fa6c13899358850a15075fa4a5b2

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add chord insertion into scores

impact_assessment.why: harmonize spawns voices from existing notes and pedal adds one note, but there is no way to insert a named-quality chord at a chosen beat.
impact_assessment.benefits: chord appends a triad at a specified beat and duration from a root and quality, leaving existing notes untouched and producing canonical source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: root must parse, quality from a fixed set, at non-negative, beats positive, pitches in MIDI range, round-trip; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for each quality, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command with --pitch/--quality/--beats, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 376 tests green; all four qualities, preservation and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-chord' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: cf22e484c50da2754767d38add02c6c7b9f6644c

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add soft-clip distortion for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: gain applies linear trim with a hard clamp and crush reduces resolution, but there is no smooth saturation effect to add warmth or glue.
impact_assessment.benefits: distort applies a deterministic soft-saturation curve with a drive control, staying bounded and byte-identical at drive 0.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: drive 0..1, drive 0 identity, all samples within range, monotonic curve, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, bounded saturation, monotonicity and determinism, a CLI command with --drive, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 381 tests green; identity, bounded saturation, monotonic magnitude and determinism pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-distort' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: ebe8892acf0c39fd398d0c3a098fd7665ed3f079

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a cascaded band-pass filter for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: lowpass and highpass exist separately, but removing rumble and hiss together needs a composed two-stage filter.
impact_assessment.benefits: bandpass chains a one-pole high-pass and low-pass in one pass with deterministic state, preserving frame count and rate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: both coefficients 0..1, known edge combinations exact, output bounded, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for the edge coefficient combinations and determinism, a CLI command with --high-alpha/--low-alpha, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 386 tests green; edge coefficients, constant removal and bounded output pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-bandpass' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add melodic interval analysis

impact_assessment.why: stats reports pitch range and density but not the melodic contour between consecutive notes, which is useful for theory analysis.
impact_assessment.benefits: intervals prints a deterministic signed semitone sequence with extremes and up/down/level counts for any score.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rests skipped, signed steps exact, empty and single-note scores handled, deterministic formatting; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests pinning the full report for known melodies, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 391 tests green; step sequences, rest handling and single-note output pinned by byte tests

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV region reversal

impact_assessment.why: reverse-wav flips an entire file, but reversing only a selected time span requires an external editor.
impact_assessment.benefits: reverse-region reverses frames inside an exact time window, leaving the head and tail byte-identical and preserving rate and length.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: 0 <= start < end finite, frame rounding exact, head/tail unchanged, out-of-range windows handled, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for middle/full windows, identity cases and validation, a CLI command reusing --start/--end, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 396 tests green; window reversal, head/tail preservation and validation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-reverse-region' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV repetition

impact_assessment.why: loop repeats a score but there is no way to repeat an already-processed WAV into a seamless loop.
impact_assessment.benefits: repeat-wav appends the source WAV N times with untouched audio bytes and unchanged sample rate; N=1 is byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: N >= 1, bounded upper limit, frame count scales exactly, sample rate preserved, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, exact tiling and validation, a CLI command reusing --times, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 400 tests green; exact tiling, frame scaling and count validation pinned by byte tests
